node.statement: Corner-algebra application. Since epsilon_A<=t, every defining extended epsilon_A-C*-inequality also holds with the larger parameter t. Node 1.2 makes P_R a nonvanishing t-projection. Node 1.1 gives t+epsilon_A<=e_ca. Hence lem-compcb-corner-algebra applies with delta=t and epsilon=epsilon_A and gives A_R=S^A_{P_R} the compressed product, inherited involution, and compressed unit u_R=Co^A_{P_R}(P_R), as an extended C_ca*(t+epsilon_A)-C*-algebra. Define epsilon_{A_R}=C_ca*(t+epsilon_A); then epsilon_{A_R}<=2*C_ca*t and u_R=I_{A_R}.
